title: Turn off the Sixfold two-day follow-up email?
detail: It has gone out by itself since 2 Nov (29 sent). Approve: a session turns it off. Decline: it stays on as it is.

title: Fix the aftercare and signed-copy footer bug?
detail: Aftercare and the signed copy get the logo header but never the social footer (a365Emails2). The fix changes what customers receive. Approve: a session fixes it, tests it and deploys it.

title: Houston photos: look into paying H-GAC for sharper ones?
detail: Free imagery tops out at the 2022 USDA photo; H-GAC sells its 2024 photos per tile. Approve: a session finds H-GAC's price and terms and brings them to you (nothing is bought). Decline: Bryce sees it as it is.

title: Start the Surge LinkedIn mock build?
detail: Built and tested against a mock until LinkedIn approves the Development tier. Nothing is connected and nothing is posted. Approve: a session starts it. Decline: it waits.
